latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Thesis Title Generator skill.

- Generates three academically appropriate bilingual (Chinese-English) thesis title pairs based on the user's thesis content or related inputs.
- Titles prioritized for accuracy, academic tone, discoverability, and fulfillment of the thesis’ scope.
- Outputs include a rationale for each title option, a recommended title, and notes on terminology or overclaiming.
- Clearly indicates when only provisional titles can be generated due to limited input.
- Strictly avoids fabricating or overstating research methods, results, or contributions.
- Ensures output quality and adherence to bilingual title equivalence and academic style guidelines.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Thesis Results Writer skill.
- Generates detailed Chinese results chapters/sections for theses and dissertations using user-supplied quantitative or qualitative data.
- Strictly limited to the results section; does not write literature review, methodology, discussion, or conclusion.
- Adheres to academic standards: reports findings objectively, uses provided tables/statistics/quotes, and follows user’s formatting requirements.
- Provides results-chapter skeletons with placeholders if no real findings are supplied.
- Reference to a built-in results-writing guide ensures consistency, structure, and proper reporting for quantitative, qualitative, and mixed-methods studies.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – generates academically rigorous methodology chapters/sections in Chinese for theses and papers.

- Determines research type (quantitative, qualitative, mixed methods, literature review, or intervention design) based on user-provided details.
- Drafts complete Chinese "第三章 研究方法/研究设计" sections, including all required subheadings and content.
- Handles missing information with clear Chinese placeholders.
- Uses detailed academic templates and local methodology writing standards.
- Provides a revision checklist after the draft for user review.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of "Thesis Literature Review Writer" skill.
- Generates detailed and academically rigorous Chinese literature review chapters or sections based on user inputs.
- Extracts thesis topic, research problem, variables, theory, method, and reference requirements from user prompts.
- Follows advanced synthesis workflow: organizes by variables, themes, mechanisms, or debates as appropriate to the research type.
- Drafts reviews using citation placeholders if references are not supplied, and recommends search terms.
- Ensures organization, critical evaluation, clear links to research questions, and adherence to formal Chinese academic writing standards.
